description: Get the registry profile of one Polish company: name, legal form, address, industry (PKD), share capital, representation rules, recent registry changes, VAT status and headline financials for the latest filed period. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP). For earlier years or full statements use get_financials.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company
title: Get Company Profile
